This reference (like the exact-arithmetic definition oracle) treats parallel edges as distinct shortest paths that share the credit. edge_betweenness_normalized: As for edge_betweenness: NetworkX over-credits parallel edges. edge_betweenness_weighted: NetworkX counts one shortest path per neighbour pair, so parallel edges of equal weight do not multiply the path count; the reference, igraph and NetworKit count each edge as a path (checked: 0->1 twice, 1->2, 0->3, 3->2, all weights 1, gives 2/3 and 1/3 for nodes 1 and 3 in the reference, 1/2 and 1/2 in NetworkX). edge_betweenness_weighted_strength: Reciprocals of whole-number weights often give path lengths that tie exactly (1/3 + 1/6 = 1/2) but differ in the last bit of floating point.
